task_completion.description: The PsychoPy Builder interface is open and active.

task_completion.description: A loop is added to the Flow that references the conditions CSV file for the three images.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Loop Properties' dialog box is visible, showing a file path to a CSV/Excel file in the 'conditions' field, or a loop icon in the Flow pane surrounding a routine.

task_completion.description: An aperture or mask component is configured with a size of 150 pixels or 0.2 height units.

task_completion.visual_evidence: The properties window for the mask/aperture shows the 'Position' field containing code like '$mouse.getPos()' and the dropdown next to it set to 'set every frame'.

task_completion.description: The experiment is saved to the specific required file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PsychoPy window title bar or a 'Save As' dialog shows the file path /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/spotlight_search.psyexp.
